name: FDF1
notes: DataCenterMap lists FDF1 in Acajou Sud, 97232 Le Lamentin, within the Fort-de-France arrondissement, as a Tier 3 small colocation/data-center facility operated by Hodi with remote hands, public cloud servers, redundant power/cooling, and Canal+ Business Telecom connectivity. Hodi's own site confirms a network of Tier III servers and datacenters in Martinique but does not publish this exact site location or MW capacity.

name: Middle Caribbean Network Le Lamentin Martinique
notes: Inflect lists a Middle Caribbean Network data center at Lareinty, Le Lamentin, Fort-de-France 97232, operated by Middle Caribbean Network, with colocation, exchange, internet access, private networking, redundant power/cooling, and enterprise telecom/data-storage use. PeeringDB corroborates Canal+ Telecom presence at MCN Le Lamentin / MARTINIX. Capacity not published.
